critique: The sparse warm orange-on-black field and stable overall particle count fit the flickering-lights concept better than prior iterations. However, each light is still a dim, brown, shaded sphere with a dark perimeter rather than a bright self-illuminated bulb or soft bokeh glow. Motion is also still wrong: nearly all lights change position between t1 and t4, including large group relocations, so it reads as drifting/re-spawning particles rather than a fixed field with independently flickering intensity.

suggestions.why: Remove initial particle velocity so the light positions remain fixed and only their brightness flickers.
Eliminate the strong Y wind that is visibly relocating the light field between frames.
Add a visible soft luminance halo around the sprite highlights so they read as illuminated bulbs/bokeh instead of shaded brown balls.
